results.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
results.proof_sketch: A9 has dimensions 52×37. By the source paper’s integer-coordinate lemma, followed by left and top stabilization, every right and bottom edge is a nonnegative sum 52i+37j. The largest such sum at most 1189 is 1188=20·52+4·37: modulo 37, a representation of 1189 would require i≡25 (mod 37), already too large. The largest such sum at most 841 is 839=14·52+3·37; the same congruence check excludes both 840 and 841. Thus all sheets lie in [0,1188]×[0,839].

results.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
results.proof_sketch: Write placements as (x,y;w,h). Use three disjoint grids: (i) (52i,37j;52,37) for 0≤i<20 and 0≤j<3, giving 60 sheets in [0,1040]×[0,111]; (ii) (1040+37i,52j;37,52) for 0≤i<4 and 0≤j<2, giving 8 sheets in [1040,1188]×[0,104]; and (iii) (37i,111+52j;37,52) for 0≤i<32 and 0≤j<14, giving 448 sheets below y=111. The grids are mutually interior-disjoint and contained in 1188×839. Their total is 60+8+448=516.

results.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
results.proof_sketch: On the reduced 1188×839 unit grid, mark precisely the cells whose lower-left coordinates satisfy x+y≡50 (mod 52), assigning each marked cell weight 1/37 and all other cells weight zero. Every 52×37 placement contains one marked cell in each of its 37 rows; every 37×52 placement contains one in each of its 37 columns. Thus every sheet has weight exactly 1. Since 1188=22·52+44 and 839=16·52+7, the number of marked cells is 52·22·16+44·16+7·22=19162; the possible high-frequency residue sets have no pair summing to 50. Total weight is therefore 19162/37=517+33/37<518. The packing cardinality is integral, so it is at most 517.

results.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
results.proof_sketch: Its sheets have area 517·52·37=994708, whereas 1187·838=994706. Consequently its normalized bounding box cannot have both width at most 1187 and height at most 838: it must span width 1188 or height 839. In the first case, a left-blocking chain ending at x=1188 has total widths 1188. The unique representation is 1188=20·52+4·37, so that chain contains twenty 52×37 and four 37×52 sheets. In the second case, a top-blocking chain has the unique height composition 839=3·37+14·52.

results.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
results.proof_sketch: Area gives OPT(1188,111)≤68, attained by the 60+8 top grids above. For a packing of N sheets in 1188×728, let n be the number oriented 52×37. For every vertical line, feasible intersection counts (h,v) satisfy 5h+7v≤98 whenever 37h+52v≤728. Summing over all columns gives 259N+n≤98·1188=116424. For every horizontal line, 52h+37v≤1188 implies 7h+5v≤160; summing gives 260N−n≤160·728=116480. Hence 519N≤232904<519·449, so N≤448. A 32×14 grid of 37×52 sheets attains 448. Thus this split permits exactly 68+448=516, not 517.

final_writeup:
The recorded interval is rigorously improved to

516 ≤ OPT(1189,841,52,37) ≤ 517.

The lower certificate is the three-grid coordinate family in Claim 2. The upper certificate is the compact periodic weight map in Claim 3; it requires no floating-point computation and checks every possible integer placement simultaneously.

There is also an independent elementary check excluding 518. Such a packing in 1188×839 would leave only 100 unit cells uncovered. Therefore at least 1088 columns and 739 rows would be completely covered. A full column has the unique decomposition 839=3·37+14·52, while a full row has the unique decomposition 1188=20·52+4·37. If n denotes the number of 52×37 sheets, full rows imply 37n≥20·739 and hence n≥400. Full columns imply 37(518−n)≥14·1088 and hence n≤106, a contradiction.

The only unresolved possibility is therefore 517. Claim 4 shows that any such construction is forced to span width 1188 or height 839 and to contain a correspondingly rigid contact chain. Claim 5 additionally rules out obtaining 517 through the most natural 111+728 horizontal decomposition.
checks_performed: Generated all 516 claimed rectangles, checked dimensions and containment, and marked the 1189×841 unit grid; exactly 992784 cells were covered and the maximum cell multiplicity was 1.
Enumerated all nonnegative sums 52i+37j within the two A0 dimensions; the maxima were exactly 1188 and 839, with representations (20,4) and (14,3).

Built the residue-50 weight map and evaluated every 52×37 window (1137·803 cases) and every 37×52 window (1152·788 cases) by exact integer prefix sums; every window contained exactly 37 marked cells. The total marker count was 19162.
Checked exactly that 1188·839−518·1924=100 and verified the unique full-column and full-row Diophantine decompositions used in the independent contradiction.
Enumerated every feasible one-dimensional intersection pattern for the 1188×728 special case; the maxima of 5h+7v and 7h+5v were respectively 98 and 160.
As a diagnostic not used for the general upper bound, an exact normal-cut dynamic program over 850708 cached subinstances returned 516 as the best recursively guillotine packing.
